title: Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 4 (USA, SLUS_217.82), MWCC PS2 3.0.1 b210 / b119 units
setup:
mkdir -p {work}/bin {work}/tmp && printf '#!/bin/sh
exec wibo "{tool:mwcps2-3.0.1b210-060308}/mwccps2.exe" "$@"
' > {work}/bin/mwcc.sh && printf '#!/bin/sh
exec wibo "{tool:mwcps2-3.0.1b119-040914}/mwccps2.exe" "$@"
' > {work}/bin/mwcc-b119.sh && chmod +x {work}/bin/*.sh && printf '#!/bin/sh
n=$#; i=0; while [ $i -lt $n ]; do a=$1; shift; case "$a" in -march=*|-mabi=*) ;; *) set -- "$@" "$a";; esac; i=$((i+1)); done
exec {tool:ee-gcc2.96}/ee/bin/as "$@"
' > {work}/bin/ee-as.sh && chmod +x {work}/bin/ee-as.sh
limits: Persona 4: the decompilation's own verifier entry point (`tools/verify.py --skip-gcc-units`, the step m22-002 ran, which compiles every C unit in src/) is run once under tests/m22-003/tools/trace/sitecustomize.py, which records the mwccgap commands it spawns; each unit is then compiled with its recorded command and the pinned MWCC PS2 3.0.1 b210 / b119 (byte-identical to the CI kit's), the pinned decompals binutils and the repo's own mwccgap. This lane is the harness's validation against m22-002.

The ee-gcc units' assembler is the pinned `ee-gcc2.96` package's `ee/bin/as` (GNU as for the EE) behind a wrapper that drops the `-march=r5900 -mabi=eabi` flags the repo's shim passes and that assembler does not know.
